verdict.rationale: Claude's first-party docs describe a unified directory where users can browse and install connectors, skills, and plugins. They also document adding connectors such as the Google Workspace ones, existing remote MCP servers, and one-click-style local MCP server installs on Desktop. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the directory, and detail on the directory's third-party catalog breadth and its browse/install flow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can browse a directory of third-party apps and connectors and add them to the assistant

citations.quote: Our unified directory brings skills, connectors, and plugins together in one place so you can find and install everything that customizes Claude without switching between separate menus.
Connect Claude to existing remote MCP servers.
you can now install local MCP servers on your computer as easily as browser extensions
Connect your Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive to Claude
